page.notes: Printed page with Arabic, Greek and Latin text. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "Niectam" (probably Nicetam), "ipsectant" (probably respectant), and the Arabic words, which I could not read letter by letter with certainty. The Arabic transcriptions are approximate. The Greek "πρὸς Θεὸν τὸν Μωάμεθ" is copied as read. The asterisk note at lower right and the Sylburg note in the right margin are placed where they stand. Catchword "liquæ" and signature "S 2" read at the foot.
